notes.title: Key Binding Patch - v1.0.09
notes.content:
We are aware that the key binding menu wasn't in the best form on the v1.0 release. Hopefully, this patch will fix most of the issues - thank you for your patience and reports!

[h2]Key Binding Menu Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Binding a key that's already in use will swap it with the current one
[*]You can now remove the binding by pressing DELETE
[*]Fixed wrong Gamepad button glyphs for Attack / Alt Attack
[*]Added missing Gamepad glyphs for Spells
[*]Renamed "Run" action to "Walk" action to avoid confusion since running is on by default
[*][b]Gamepad controls couldn't (and still can't) be changed[/b], but the system allowed binding gamepad buttons, which trigger double-controller bind issues. As a result, we now filter out gamepad button prompts when assigning a new key to avoid confusion.
[*]Fixed some other minor issues regarding the keybinding.
[/list]
 If you continue to experience issues with the key bindings after this update, please let us know. 

[h2]Level Editor[/h2]
[list]
[*]Passages can now be disabled with Deactivator
[*]Background Setter editor object text changed from "Music Setter" to "BCG Setter"
[*]Another tip added to the normal mode ([i]Shift + Click to disconnect objects[/i])
[/list]

notes.title: Chronicles of Terrabruma - Update v1.0.06
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, adventurers! ːCotcTorchː[/h3]
Hope you're enjoying your time in Terrabruma so far!

[h2]Lore Fragments & Chronicles[/h2]
This update adds Lore Fragments to all existing levels, which speak of events and sometimes hint at hidden areas and puzzles. By discovering all of these concealed fragments, players will unlock the corresponding Chronicle for each level, providing insights into their lore. We also added two new achievements related to them for the brave explorers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/6327de497342a6c6441e883b6e45303e9caa622f.png[/img]

[h2]Modding - Creature Customization added[/h2]
We promised that we would keep expanding the modding capabilities for Wizordum, and this is the first step on that path. [b]You can now, through the mod script, mod existing enemies, changing their sprites, health, and damage they deal.[/b] [url=https://mod.io/g/wizordum/r/enemy-customization]We also prepared a guide[/url] so you can have a quick start at it!

We want to see your crazy enemy designs now, no more excuses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/f67eba9551965670c47032ce6e7eecfa6510afac.png[/img]
[i]Naughty blue goblin caster with Santa hat...because why not![/i]

Do you need help with modding/level creation or just want to discuss the process? [url=https://discord.gg/F2TfW2ZAAm]Join our Discord server[/url] to hang out with fellow modders.

[h3]UPDATES[/h3]
- The level name is displayed on the map and in the loading screen before entering the level.
- Gamepad sensitivity lower-end setting extended to allow lower sensitivity 
- [Ep1. Secret Level] Music changed & Magic Map added so you can activate Moonlight Chart 
- New Achievements added related to lore fragments (Bookworm & Lore Master)
- Improved spell replenish rate for all character spells
- Minor Mod Browser updates
- [Level editor] Boulder Spawners are now available

[h3]FIXES[/h3]

- Saving while skeletons/undead rise and loading after that will get them stuck in a fake-death pose.
- Achievements not triggering: "Dark Wizard", "Curiosity Killed a Mage", "Big Spender"
- The Boss 2 music intro plays too fast
- Remaining enemies in the final boss fight will now die after defeating the boss
- The Final Boss could stay alive under some conditions
- [Moonlight Chart] Treasure Icon not disappearing when looting a dead body with treasure
- 'Hotheels' achievement fixed (Fire Shield & Arcane Shield will both pause the achievement timer now)
- [E3L03] Glitches & Air Walk
- Rare bug where music won't load properly / gets stuck
- Flame Bars & Cutters - disabled states not saving properly
- Magic Piglets are not moving
- Errors specific to old user adventures that were not updated

Thank you all for playing the game and sharing your feedback/bugs! [b]There's more to come so stay tuned![/b]

[i]Primoz (Lead Dev)[/i]

notes.title: Minor Update v1.0.05
notes.content:
For a long time (even in the Early Access), lots of players had problems finding the last 1% of the treasure. Treasure seeking was part of our initial idea, and it is in no way mandatory, but we know there are lots of you who enjoy the process. However, missing the last 1% can be really annoying, especially when a pile of copper coins hides amongst barrel remains.

That's why we added a new character update to the shop - [b]Moonlight Chart[/b]. After collecting 98% of the treasure in the level, the rest will be revealed on your magic map ([i]goblet icon[/i]). You still need to find the majority of the treasure, but the upgrade will help you with the final pieces and save you some trouble.

notes.title: The most hated Sewers level - Reforged
notes.content:
Since the early access launch of Wizordum, Murky Wastes, the infamous sewers level, has received many negative opinions. Being the 3rd level in the game, the level was very long, and the difficulty spike was quite big. Not to mention tedious backtracking and many switches - we just wanted to stay true to the tradition of sewer levels. However, it didn't turn out as we hoped it would.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/e9314b0ef4fda173efbb555236f38f33bb514ea7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/920251c13ff803a876400181a06ca70335f443ee.png[/img]

Because of that, we decided to go back to the Murky Wastes and flip some things around to get rid of most of the backtracking and to make the whole level slightly more linear, so it's harder to get lost now. As a result of this, we have a shorter and more enjoyable level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/e21fcdb6b6d7d6ada48f1a7264440ec0fb34eadc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/1d675905b999cbb7a90b8aa6287f42f44591e3d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/4e1855755fc59616cff166be8b1ba5028bc23d6a.png[/img]

Hopefully, this will make the overall experience better for everyone! And if you loved the old vanilla Murky Wastes, don't fret. We will upload it as a custom map soon so you can experience the original map whenever you want.

[h3]Storm Gauntlets - Chain of Lightning Alternative Attack[/h3]
If you have purchased the Storm Gauntlets upgrade at the shop, you can now use the alternative attack, connecting up to five enemies with a Chain of Lightning, dealing 20 damage per enemy in the chain.

[b]Enjoy the new update, and let us know how you like the new Murky Wastes, Mage![/b] 🧙‍♂️

notes.title: Episode 2 Available NOW
notes.content:
It is time to continue your journey through Terrabruma, Mage!
 
Wield the Storm Gauntlets and master new spells to fight hordes of Chaos and follow its trail! Mount vicious, oversized rodents to trample warmongers and exchange scavenged loot for upgrades at the new Sorcerer's Shop. 

[previewyoutube=s97Kuvjipno;full][/previewyoutube]

We worked hard over the past few months not only to bring you a new episode but also to improve the game from your suggestions, making it better than it ever was.

[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]

[h3]Sorcerer's Shop[/h3]
You can now spend hard-earned treasures at the Sorcerer's Shop after each level to unlock weapon upgrades (secondary attacks), spell enhancements, and character improvements.

[h3]New Weapon[/h3]
[b]Storm Gauntlets[/b] - Use the gloves to master the energy of the Storm to caused quick and deadly damage to your enemies.

[h3]Weapon Upgrades[/h3]
Each weapon has a new, alternative attack mode that will spice up spellcasting. Unlock Fire Rings' Fire Breathing ability to burn enemies up close or spawn Pyroblast's Scrochlash orb that will act as a fire turret.
[i]NOTE: Storm Gauntlets don't have the alternative attack yet. [/i]

[h3]New Spell System[/h3]
Learn up to 4 spells throughout the two episodes and combine them with your magic weapons to become the ultimate Mage of Wiozrdum. Defeating your enemies will replenish the spells so make sure you keep using them!
[i]NOTE: Some spells were moved from consumables to the new Spell System (Repulsion, Hellfire, Wizard's Wrath).[/i]


[h3]New Consumables[/h3]
Consumables that moved to the Spell System were replaced with new Consumable Scrolls like Frost Breath, Blink, and Arcane Shield. Other additions, like Haste Potion, will make you move faster for a short duration.

[h3]New Episode[/h3]
Like the first episode, Episode 2 features 7 levels besides the bonus level. The secret level is also in development. 

Please note that we had some unforeseen delays, so we had to ship this update without the final boss of Episode 2, but we will release an update soon after this update to conclude the story of this chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/5ebc50a9e9d4b792fa23b6ebdb8b6cc4c9511a9e.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fire spells will put players and enemies on fire
[*] Damage indicators added
[*] Magic Bomb counter is now displayed on HUD 
[*] Pyroblast area of damage improvement
[*] Lots of bug fixes and changes.
[*] The gameplay area changed from one layer to all layers
[/list]

Many more requested features & updates are planned, so rest assured that we will keep improving the game. We are also aware of some bugs that need to be fixed, and that's what we will do in the following days.

Thank you for leaving your reviews and feedback to us so we can keep making the game better.

[b]Please let us know how you feel about this update and you're welcome to report any possible bugs you might find. [/b]

[b]Enjoy the new update![/b] ːCotcTorchː

notes.title: Wizordum Roadmap
notes.content:
First of all, I would like to thank everyone for playing the game! We are thrilled to see the game standing at the [b]Very Positive[/b] rating, and we appreciate every bit of the feedback we received from you so far!

We have said this many times, but we are reading your feedback on all possible channels. This roadmap might not show every little detail we have in store for you, but we'll keep doing more of what you love and making some drastic but positive changes to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043182/8bbc29a4b5fd00c9be4863440148de4d5950bc2f.png[/img]

I'm sure you have questions after going over this Roadmap, so I will go ahead and add some clarifications.

[h3]New Spell System[/h3]
We watched a lot of streams and videos of Wizordum, and we've noticed that most players don't even use consumable items and spells. Lots of feedback was given about this issue as well. 
Because of that, we will introduce a Spell System that will make using spells more practical and fun. We will still have consumables, but they will be used for Potions, Torches, and other items. We will talk more about the system in the near future.

[h3] Merchant & Coins[/h3]
Treasure in Wizordum was always meant for bonus points only so that you could climb up the online leaderboards. However, it turns out most of you would prefer to have a store in the game where you could exchange that treasure for something more practical. With this system, you will be able to spend your coins to upgrade your Spells and weapons and buy a few other things. Rest assured, score hunters, the classic score hunting, will stay as well. 

[h3]Alternative attacks for all Weapons[/h3]
Lots of you asked for alternative attacks to make weapons even more fun, and we're going to do just that. So far, only the Frostweaver has the alternative attack, and we are releasing an update soon with the Mace's alternative attack, but are already planning some great alternatives for the rest. 

[h3]New Playable Character[/h3]
With the new Spell System in place, we would like to introduce additional playable characters as well with a different spell arsenal, stats, and possibly even some weapons so you can re-play the game in a different way.


[h3]Last Update Before the Next Big Content Update[/h3]
We want to stabilize the game with one final update so we can focus 100% on the next big update - Episode 2. There's a lot to do, and we would like to keep the focus there.


[h2]What about other stuff?[/h2]
There are other minor and more significant changes we are planning to do over the course of the Early Access or for the v1.0. Here are some of them without a specific date or order. 
[list]
[*] Changing the Sewers level from Episode 1 to make it more fun
[*] Possibly splitting the City of Ember from Episode 1 into two maps while adding something extra to both.
[*] Rebalancing levels (adjusting pickups, enemies, etc.)
[*] Adding Collectible Lore Scrolls to the levels, which will reveal bits of the story
[*] Updating the AI to make enemy encounters more fun
[*] Additional input support (e.g., consumable / weapon selection wheel)
[*] Map Editor improvements
[*] Animated Story Screens
[/list]

Please remember that everything can change slightly, from features to dates, but this is the active plan we are following. That also means that any new feedback is still very valuable.

I hope you like what you're seeing on the Roadmap. Is there anything specific you are incredibly excited about? Let us know!

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/wizordum/]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

[*] [Map Editor] Help Button added that will take you to [url=https://mod.io/g/wizordum/r]Wizordum's Mod.io page with official level editor guides[/url].
[/list]

[h2]ːCotcShovelː Fixes[/h2]
For this update, we mainly focused on the Secret Level, optimizations, and the new Save Game system, so we didn't pay much attention to the rest and only fixed what we could in the given time. Please note that all bug reports are noted and put on our to-do list. Rest assured, we will get to them!
[list]
[*]Broken achievements fixed ([i]Hydrated, Fortune Finder, Treasure Hunter[/i])
[*]You can now skip the story and splash the screen with any input key, not just mouse clicks.
[*]Bug fixed where all Undead started hidden even when they were flagged as risen.
[*]Unlit Street lamps can be destroyed with mace now
[*]When saving after teleporting, the correct ambient will be applied on load now
[*]Treasure Goblin trigger won't re-activate on Game Load anymore to avoid endless score grind
[*]If the game is saved while the Treasure Goblin is spawned, the goblin will properly load with the load game
[*] The issue where you couldn't traverse through some passages on game-load is solved (eg. one at the end of the Mourning Grounds)
[*] Fixed various visual issues (z-fighting, wrong textures, etc.)
[*]Bat's shadow will disappear now if you freeze and shatter it
[*]Undead that has risen will now appear as risen on game load even if you don't damage them.
[*][Map Editor] Weird behavior for moving objects that snap to tile solved
[*][Map Editor] When creating and saving a new map, it will now appear in list of Adventure maps
[*][Map Editor] Assigning a new map to the adventure will now work without restarting the game
[*][Map Editor] Moving effector/actors that snap to tile won't snap to invalid position anymore
[*]Various minor fixes in levels & game systems
[/list]

[h2]ːCotcKeyː Input[/h2]
We realize that we still have to do a lot of fixes and updates to support the gamepad fully, but with this update, you should be able to play the game only with the gamepad, without the assistance of the mouse. 
[list]
[*]The gamepad will be detected and used if you plug it in/turn it on when the game is already running
[*]You can navigate all the menus with the gamepad now
[*]Missing sounds when navigating the settings
[*]You can now change any "Selector" values with keys/gamepad (e.g., crosshair selector)
[*]Showing gamepad buttons on interaction actions
[*] The game will live-switch between Keyboard and mouse / Gamepad, depending on what you're using, and change input icons and show the mouse cursor accordingly.
[/list]

First, I would like to address the change to the Save System. You might have noticed that your save files got corrupted a few times already since the release with almost every update. We tried to solve this issue without making significant changes, but we realized that's impossible with our flawed system. So, to provide long-term support and stability of your save files, we had to rewrite how the save games work. That includes changes to the level format. We apologize for the possible loss of your current save game files. This should provide stability for a long while.

[b]Last but not least, we are planning some things for January 2024:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Roadmap [/b]to show you where we're heading and what can you expect from the game in the future
[*] First [b]Map Making event[/b]
[/list]

Thank you for making this year magical for us by playing Wizordum and showing your constant support through feedback and bug reports! 2024 is going to be the biggest for Wizordum and we can't wait to bring you more of it.

[b]Follow us[/b]
[list]

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/wizordum/]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

Peace, love, and Happy New Year! ːCotcHeartː

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0.4
notes.content:
Another batch of updates and fixes is here. We hope you're enjoying your time in Terrabruma so far!

[img]http://emberheartgames.com/wizordum/wizordum-snow.png[/img]

[b]ːCotcKeyː New & Updated[/b] 
[list]
[*] First snowflakes appeared on the Main Menu
[*] Bonus Level won't automatically finish anymore after beating all the Royal Piglets.
[/list]

[b]ːCotcMiningCartː Fixes[/b] 
[list]
[*] Achievement 'Fortune Founder' can be achieved now

[*] Holes and Tile issues in 'Grim Haven' patched
[*] Performance increased in the 'Murky Wastes'
[*] Enemies won't rise up from the dead after you die anymore

[*] Skeletons that are faking death won't mess up the events that require kills to proceed anymore (happening in Mourning Grounds)

[h3]Safety of your Save Games in the long run[/h3]
Your current save files are safe this time, but we found a severe issue with the save game system, which prevents us from keeping the save games safe in the long run through updates. We will have to rewrite this part to provide persistable save files that are safe from corruption. When we release that update, we will also provide a backup branch that will allow you to play the previous version, so you can finish the game without losing the saves.

Thank you for all the bug reports and your feedback so far! We are reading everything and try to reply when possible. You can send your feedback and nasty bugs at our [url=https://discord.gg/QVQH5rB5]Discord [/url]or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1715590/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url].

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
One week has passed since we launched our first public demo, and the response we have received so far is astounding! It is nice to see many players enjoying the game, even if it's just a small demo, which means we are doing something right, and we'll keep doing what we do.

Although the feedback was overall very positive, you also reported some issues you were having with the game, so we tried to address most of them in this patch.

[h2]Updates ːCotcTorchː[/h2] 
[list]
[*] FOV slider added
[*] Hitboxes and projectiles improved ([i]you will hardly miss now with your weapons, and rats are much less of an annoyance[/i])
[*] Mouse sensitivity slider values adjusted
[*] Default game settings updated 
[*] You can now switch weapons with a Scroll Wheel
[*] Invisibility cloak duration increased from 10s to 15s
[*] Bronze key visuals updated, so they look less like a gold key 
[*] More loot added to the barrels in both demo levels
[*] You can now destroy grain sacks ([i]yes, those are grain sacks and not gold bags[/i])
[*] Pillars have better collision
[*] [b]Gamepad controls[/b] improved which makes game playable on [b]Steam Deck[/b] as well
- Switching weapons with bumpers
- Navigating consumables with D-PAD (left, right) and consuming them (up).
- Interactions (South button)
- Attack (triggers / west button)
- Map (north button)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes ːCotcShovelː[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Pressing ALT+TAB won't disable strafing anymore when returning to the game
[*] Music is now looping properly
[*] Goblin Berserk stray pixel removed from death animation
[*] Weapon switching broken if you opened a map while firing
[*] Cinematic black bars now work correctly on all resolutions
[*] Invisibility effect won't stuck if you finish a level while under the effect
[*] If you enter the passage (transition) while the pickup effect is in progress, the pickup glow effect won't be stuck.
[/list]

With all these changes, the demo should be much more enjoyable, all thanks to your feedback! There are other things that we will be updating and fixing, but it will take a bit longer. 

We read and appreciate all the feedback we get, even if we don't reply to you immediately. If you are new here, feel free to leave your feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1715590/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/Gc7Kgp3]Discord[/url] or send it directly to our [url=wizordum@emberheartgames.com]email[/url].

Wizordum is [url=https://www.patreon.com/wizordum]100% funded by Patreon[/url], so if you would like to support the game further, this is something you can consider. Every little bit helps! ːcc_candleː

Thank you for your support, enjoy the game! 🧙‍♂️
